name: Question 3
problem:
Let $X$ and $Y$ be two continuous random variables with the following joint probability density function:

$$
f(x,y)={\begin{aligned}\frac{2y(2x+3y)}{5}, & \,1\le x\le 2,\,0\le y\le 1 \\ 0, & \,\text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

Find the expression of the conditional probability density function ${f}_{X\,|\,Y}(x\,|\,y)$ for $1\le x\le 2,\,0\le y\le 1.$
worked_solution:
Using the formula for the marginal density function for $Y,$ we have 

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}_{Y}(y) & ={\int }_{-\infty }^{\infty }f(x,y)\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}\frac{2y(2x+3y)}{5}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}(\frac{4xy}{5}+\frac{6{y}^{2}}{5})\text{d}x \\  & ={[\frac{2{x}^{2}y}{5}+\frac{6x{y}^{2}}{5}]}_{x=1}^{x=2} \\  & =\frac{8y}{5}+\frac{12{y}^{2}}{5}-\frac{2y}{5}-\frac{6{y}^{2}}{5} \\  & =\frac{6{y}^{2}}{5}+\frac{6y}{5} \\  & =\frac{6y(y+1)}{5}.\end{aligned}
$$

So, the full expression for ${f}_{Y}(y)$ is the following:

$$
{f}_{Y}(y)={\begin{aligned}\frac{6y(y+1)}{5}, & \,0\le y\le 1 \\ 0, & \,\text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

Now recall that the conditional probability density function of $X$ given $Y=y$ for two continuous random variables $X$ and $Y$ is given by

$$
{f}_{X\,|\,Y}(x\,|\,y)=\frac{f(x,y)}{{f}_{Y}(y)},
$$

where

- $f(x,y)$ is the joint probability density function for $X$ and $Y,$ and

- ${f}_{Y}(y)$ is the marginal density function for $Y.$

Now, for $1\le x\le 2,\,0\le y\le 1,$ we have 

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}_{X\,|\,Y}(x\,|\,y) & =\frac{f(x,y)}{{f}_{Y}(y)} \\  & =\frac{(\frac{2y(2x+3y)}{5})}{(\frac{6y(y+1)}{5})} \\  & =\frac{2x+3y}{3(y+1)}.\end{aligned}
$$

For other values of $x$ and $y,$ the function $f(x,y)$ equals $0.$ As a result, ${f}_{X\,|\,Y}(x\,|\,y)$ will be equal to $0$ too.

Therefore, the conditional probability density function is the following:

$$
{f}_{X\,|\,Y}(x\,|\,y)={\begin{aligned}\frac{2x+3y}{3(y+1)}, & \,1\le x\le 2,\,0\le y\le 1 \\ 0, & \,\text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

Let X and Y be two continuous random variables with the following joint probability density function: f(x,y)={2y(2x+3y)5,1≤x≤2,0≤y≤10,otherwise

Find the expression of the conditional probability density function fX|Y(x|y) for 1≤x≤2,0≤y≤1.

a
2x+3y
b
2(y+1)5(2x+3y)
c
2x+3y3(y+1)

(2x+3y)(y+1)3

5y(x+y)

So, the full expression for fY(y) is the following: fY(y)={6y(y+1)5,0≤y≤10,otherwise

where

  • fY(y) is the marginal density function for Y.

Now, for 1≤x≤2,0≤y≤1, we have fX|Y(x|y)=f(x,y)fY(y)=(2y(2x+3y)5)(6y(y+1)5)=2x+3y3(y+1).
